publicReleaseNotes: Pantry 0.2.0 turns v0.1.0's books into connected bookkeeping for one US business. Bank and card lines arrive through your own Plaid keys or statement files, and bank rules file the routine ones with a preview and an undo. Receipts are photographed, uploaded or forwarded, read with your own AI key and attached when you accept them. Invoices are emailed with a PDF and a customer page, followed up by reminders and repeated on a schedule; a deposit that names the invoice matches itself, and customers can pay by card from the link through your own Stripe. Every P&L and balance sheet figure opens to its records, documents and bank lines, on the cash or the accrual basis, with sales tax by state and 1099 contractors. Pantry asks about what doesn't add up, by email first, before close. Stripe payouts and Gusto payrolls book themselves, and you can move in from Xero as well as QuickBooks Online. Adding a person sends their sign-in invitation, and Put Pantry online fills the deploy lines with your own email. Upgrading from 0.1.0 applies migrations 0015 to 0023 in order and keeps every entry, document, reconciliation, sign-in and locked month, including books whose bank lines are matched: back up first, then git pull and rer dev on your own computer, or the hosted backup, git pull and rer deploy for a hosted Pantry. The checkout pins rer 0.2.43.
agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.1.0, back up first. On your own computer: rer dev --stop, rer export --output exports/pantry-books-0.1.0.rer, git pull, rer dev (installs the pinned rer 0.2.43 and applies migrations 0015 to 0023 in order). Hosted: from the deploying checkout with its .rer folder and .env.pantry, rer queue hosted-backup -- node scripts/hosted-backup.mjs --env-file .env.pantry, git pull, rer deploy --env-file .env.pantry (add --environment NAME to both if one was used); rer export saves only local books, never use it for a hosted backup. If the owner committed MAIL_PROVIDER or MAIL_FROM into deploy.json for 0.1.0, git pull stops with a conflict in deploy.json: put MAIL_PROVIDER and MAIL_FROM in .env.pantry, then git checkout --theirs deploy.json, git add deploy.json and git commit before deploying. A hosted update that already stopped at 0018_bank_rules_feeds.sql with FOREIGN KEY constraint failed needs its unfinished step cleared once: npx wrangler d1 execute pantry-<environment>-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM d1_migrations WHERE name='0018_bank_rules_feeds.sql' AND state='applying'" with the .env.pantry Cloudflare token, then rer deploy (docs/hosting.md, Keep it current). Migrations 0001 to 0014 are unchanged; 0018, 0020 and 0022 rebuild pt_bank_lines, pt_audit and pt_cutovers, copying every row, and 0018 sets matched bank lines aside around its rebuild. migrations/rewrites.json declares 0018's reviewed rewrite, so installs that applied the earlier 0018 bytes keep deploying. Do not reset or restore into the populated installation. New provider features (Plaid, Stripe, Gusto, Xero, AI key, mail provider) stay off until their keys are added; Pantry on your own computer sends no email. Run rer verify and pnpm run verify:release --from v0.1.0 before adopting.
